nodes.description: A heterozygous germline missense or in-frame deletion variant in the CARD, LATCH or coiled-coil domain of CARD11. In the resting state an inhibitory linker domain holds CARD11 closed by occluding exactly those domains, and antigen receptor signalling normally opens it by phosphorylating serines in that linker. These alleles decouple the two steps, so the protein behaves as if the linker had already been phosphorylated.

nodes.description: A separate B cell defect that runs alongside the expansion and explains why humoral immunity is poor despite an excess of B cells. Purified naive BENTA B cells survive better than normal donor B cells in vitro and still fail to become plasmablasts or long-lived plasma cells in response to a range of stimuli, with reduced IgG production and poor induction of the genes required for plasma cell commitment. This is the node that makes the immunodeficiency intrinsic rather than secondary to the lymphocytosis.

It is also the allele of the reported mother whose course included polyarthritis and encephalitis, and of a child who met diagnostic criteria for haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.
